archimate:ApplicationService.name: Task Assignment abd Workflow Service
archimate:ApplicationService.documentation:
A Task Assignment & Workflow Service is an orchestration system that automatically generates, prioritizes, and routes specific clinical and administrative tasks to designated healthcare staff based on structured workflow rules and clinical events.
Its purpose is to automate and standardize complex, multi-step healthcare processes, ensuring that the correct responsibilities are handed off to the right team members at the precise moment they are needed.
Example: Upon a patient’s admission for elective surgery, this service automatically assigns a pre-operative checklist to the nursing staff, schedules a medication review for the clinical pharmacist, and triggers a room-prep task for the environmental services team.
